answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is stake-weighted endorsement: every new identity must lock a small refundable bond, like basalt bedrock beneath a house, before its attestations carry weight. Forging a thousand fake agents then means paying a thousand bonds, pushing the attacker onto a steep financial ledge where each fake identity risks a slashing penalty if collusion is detected. Honest agents earn back their bond and build trust over epochs, so the genuine network spreads wide like a meadow while cheap disposable identities become too costly to mass-produce.
